saa-med-181.text: A company migrated an internal management system to an instance Amazon EC2 Which one's running 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, with use of CPU and stable and predictable memory throughout the year. What option to buy the Amazon EC2 meets this requirement?
options: Acquire one Reserved Instance (Standard) 1 or 3 years for the type and region of the instance, obtaining a significant discount on the price On-Demand in exchange for the commitment of use.
Configure the AWS Budgets to send an alert when the cost of the instance exceeds a certain monthly limit.
Migrate the instance to Spot Instances, which offer the biggest discounts available in EC2, may even reach 90% regarding On-Demand.

Reserved Instances (RIs) Standard offer the MAIORES discounts (until ~72% compared to On-Demand) in exchange for COMPROMISSO of 1 or 3 years for a specific instance configuration (family, size, region). For a workload STAVEL AND PREVIOUS that will continue running 24/7 for the next few years 1-3 years, this is the purchase model that maximizes the economy, exactly the scenario described.

optionRationales: Correct. For a workload STAVEL AND PREVIOUS that will continue running 24/7 for the next few years 1-3 years, this is the purchase model that maximizes the economy, exactly the scenario described.

Incorrect. Spot Instances offer bigger discounts, they can be INTERROMPIDAS for AWS with only 2 warning minutes when capacity is required for On-Demand instances — unsuitable for an internal management system that needs to run CONTINUOUS and ESTABLE 24/7, without tolerance to unexpected interruptions.

Incorrect. Auto Scaling Group with a minimum and maximum equal to 1 does not affect the MODELO IN PRICE OF THE INSTANCE — it would continue to be charged at the On-Demand rate (more expensive), without any discount per commitment. REDUZIR the cost in relation to On-Demand.

Incorrect. AWS Budgets is a tool of MONITORAMENTO And ALERTA costs — it NOTIFICA when expenditure exceeds defined limits, but no ALTERA the price charged by the court does not offer any discount; does not meet the requirement to reduce the cost of computing itself..

saa-med-182.text: A technology company performs various workloads: some in instances Amazon EC2, other in containers AWS Fargate, and others in office AWS Lambda. Savings Plans offer significant discounts (similar to Reserved Instances) in exchange for a COMPROMISSO OF GASTO (USD/hour) by 1 or 3 years — but, unlike RIs, this commitment is INDEPENDENTE family of instance, size, operating system, tenancy or region, and applies AUTOMATICAMENTE to eligible use in EC2, Fargate and Lambda. This offers the desired discount while maintaining complete flexibility for the company to migrate between types of instance and regions.

saa-med-183.text: A media company processes batch video rendering: jobs are sent to a row of Amazon SQS, and one Auto Scaling Group of Entities EC2 consume the queue, process each job (which can take a few minutes to a few hours) and save the result in Amazon S3. Reduce maximum size of Auto Scaling Group for 1 instance, processing jobs sequentially to save cost.

saa-med-183.explanation: Correct. Spot Instances offer the MAIORES discount EC2 (until ~90% compared to On-Demand), using computational capacity EXCEDENTE of AWS — in return, the AWS may INTERROMPER the instance with 2 minutes of warning when capacity is needed. As the scenario describes a workload that already TOLERA interruptions (jobs reprocessed via SQS Visibility Timeout), Spot Instances are the option of MENOR CUSTO adequate, maximizing the economy without compromising the reliability of processing.
saa-med-183.hint: Think of what model of purchase of the EC2 offers the MAIORES discounts (until ~90% in relation to On-Demand) taking advantage of the unused computational capacity of AWS, being ideal for workloads TOLERANTES INTERRUPTIONS.
optionRationales: Correct. Spot Instances offer the MAIORES discount EC2 (until ~90% compared to On-Demand), using computational capacity EXCEDENTE of AWS — in return, the AWS may INTERROMPER the instance with 2 minutes of warning when capacity is needed. As the scenario describes a workload that already TOLERA interruptions (jobs reprocessed via SQS Visibility Timeout), Spot Instances are the option of MENOR CUSTO adequate, maximizing the economy without compromising the reliability of processing.

Reserve for PICO historical would mean paying for capacity RESERVADA even during periods of low demand (when Auto Scaling reduces the number of instances) — this is less cost-effective than Spot Instances for a VARIABLE and TOLERANTE INTERRUPTIONS, in addition to not offering the maximum possible discount (~90%) that Spot offers.

Incorrect. AWS Lambda has a time limit of execution of 15 minutes by invocation — video rendering jobs that may take a few hours' EXCEDERIAM this limit, making the Lambda INADEQUADO for this workload, regardless of cost considerations.

Incorrect. Limit to 1 instance would increase DRASTICAMENTE the total processing time (jobs of hours processed sequentially, not in parallel) — this is not a strategy of OTIMIZATION OF CUSTO POR HORA COMPUTATION (the hourly price of the instance continues the same, On-Demand), only reduces the parallelization, damaging the throughput without the discount that Spot Instances provide.

saa-med-184.text: A health company stores, in a pocket Amazon S3 in the class S3 Standard, patient records that should be RETIDOS by regulatory requirement by 10 years. saa-med-184.explanation: Right. S3 Lifecycle can TRANSICIONAR AUTOMATICAMENTE objects for classes of ARQUIVAMENTO (S3 Flexible Retrieval Glacier or S3 Glacier Deep Archive) after a defined period (ex.: 30 These classes offer the following types of services: MENORES storage costs of the S3, with recovery times (minutes to hours, depending on the option) compatible with the 'up to 12 hours acceptable for rare audits' — taking into account the cost minimisation while maintaining the durability of 11 of the S3.
saa-med-184.hint: Think of a life-cycle rule of S3 which transitions the objects to the storage class of ARQUIVAMENTO of MENOR cost, suitable for rarely accessed data with time recovery times.
optionRationales: Right. S3 Lifecycle can TRANSICIONAR AUTOMATICAMENTE objects for classes of ARQUIVAMENTO (S3 Flexible Retrieval Glacier or S3 Glacier Deep Archive) after a defined period (ex.: 30 These classes offer the following types of services: MENORES storage costs of the S3, with recovery times (minutes to hours, depending on the option) compatible with the 'up to 12 hours acceptable for rare audits' — taking into account the cost minimisation while maintaining the durability of 11 of the S3.

Incorrect. S3 Transfer Acceleration is a resource for ACELERAR long-distance data transfers (using the edge network of the CloudFront) — it affects the VELOCIDADE upload/download and can even add cost, but does NOT reduce the cost of ARMAZENAMENTO of objects, which is the focus of the requirement.

saa-med-185.text: A startup stores user files (photos, documents, videos) in a pocket Amazon S3. saa-med-185.explanation: Right. S3 Intelligent-Tiering was designed exactly for data with access patterns DESCONHECIDOS or CHANGE: it automatically monitors the access pattern of CADA object and move between levels (frequent, infrequent, and optionally archiving) SEM latency impact on objects at the frequent level and SEM require the team to create/manage manual life cycle rules — optimizing cost automatically as the actual use of each object evolves.

optionRationales: Right. Class S3 One Zone-IA stores data in UMA ONLY Area of Availability (less durability/availability) and still collects TAXAS RECOVERY by GB accessed — for files that become POPULARES suddenly (high access frequency), these rates would accumulate significantly, in addition to the risk of data loss in case of single AZ failure, unlike the Intelligent-Tiering that adapts without recovery rates at the frequent level.

saa-med-186.text: A company operates a 50 cases Amazon EC2 which have been provided for more than a year, in various sizes (m5.2xlarge, c5.xlarge, r5.large, etc.), chosen at the time without a formal sizing process. optionRationales: Correct. AWS Configure Evaluation CONFORMIDADE CONFIGURATION against rules — although it is possible to create custom rules related to metrics, the AWS Config was not designed to generate recommendations from TIPOS OF THE INSTANCE ALTERNATIVOS with estimates of economy; this is the specific and native function of AWS Optimizer Computers.

saa-med-187.text: A web application hosted in a Auto Scaling Group of Entities EC2, behind a Application Load Balancer, receives significantly higher traffic during business hours (8h at 18h, working days) and minimum traffic during the night and weekends. Auto Scaling Group uses only Target Tracking Scaling based on the use of CPU, but the team realized that, at the beginning of business hours (at 8h), it takes a few minutes for new instances to be launched and ready, causing a brief degradation of performance every day until the scaling based on CPU The team wants to GARANTIR that adequate capacity is already available ANTES the foreseeable start of peak time, without permanently increasing the minimum capacity (which would generate unnecessary cost during the night). Scheduled Scaling allows you to define steps that occur in SPECIFIC AND RECORRENTES (e.g.: 'every working day at 7h45, define minimum/desirable capacity for X'), increasing PROATIVAMENTE capacity ANTES the foreseeable onset of peak traffic — eliminating degradation caused by reactive scaling lag based on CPU. Outside of these scheduled times, Target Tracking Scaling continues to adjust capacity dynamically, and minimum capacity PERMANENTE does not need to be increased (avoiding unnecessary cost during the night).
saa-med-187.hint: Think of a kind of policy of Auto Scaling which allows to define ACTIONS OF ESCALONAMENTO IN SPECIFIC AND RECORRENTES, adjusting the minimum/desired capacity in a forward-looking manner, in conjunction with the already existing dynamic scaling.
optionRationales: Correct. Scheduled Scaling allows you to define steps that occur in SPECIFIC AND RECORRENTES (e.g.: 'every working day at 7h45, define minimum/desirable capacity for X'), increasing PROATIVAMENTE capacity ANTES the foreseeable onset of peak traffic — eliminating degradation caused by reactive scaling lag based on CPU. Outside of these scheduled times, Target Tracking Scaling continues to adjust capacity dynamically, and minimum capacity PERMANENTE does not need to be increased (avoiding unnecessary cost during the night).

Incorrect. Increase the MINIMUM Capacity PERMANENTEMENTE means paying for the ability to PICO during TODA night and weekends (when traffic is minimal) — the scenario explicitly asks for EVITAR this 'unnecessary cost during the night', which is exactly the problem that Scheduled Scaling solves without waste.

Simple Scaling is not inherently faster than Target Tracking — both are DINAMIC and REATIVO, which only adjust the capacity APOS to metric (CPU) to exceed a limit, i.e. there would still be a lag at the beginning of the peak at 8h. The problem requires action PROATIVA based on HORARIO, not a different reactive policy.

Incorrect. Rejecting connections of LEGITIMOUS USERS during the start of business hours would worsen the user's experience (the original problem was already 'performance degradation', and that would be worse — unavailable) — the goal is GARANTIR sufficient capacity ANTES from the peak, do not deny access until it is available.

Io2 Block Express is designed for workloads EXTREMAMENTE EXIGENTES (critical mission databases that need up to 256.000 IOPS) and it has a cost POR IOPS MAIS ALTO that gp3 — for a 'moderate and consistent' workload that only needs 5.000 IOPS, migrating to io2 Block Express would increase the cost, not reduce it, being unnecessary oversize.

saa-med-189.text: An application executed in instances EC2 in a private sub-network read and record large volumes of data (various TB per month) in buckets Amazon S3.
